svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.alaska-flag-layout-context", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Selected Alaska flag layout: seven smaller upright five-pointed BigDipper stars plus one larger upper-right Polaris star, with no connecting lines or extra star. 240x165mm frame on280x205mm page. Seven14mm circumdiameter markers and one20mm marker are declared accessible enlargements from the pinned source bitmap; centres approximately retained, not sewing dimensions. Line boundaries do not inherently encode gold/blue; external accessible colour/context key required. Not an astronomical chart, legal-ratio or recognition claim.", "geometry_exception": "Index native1.2mm line-sampling dots with3.1mm centre guard;shared junctions de-duplicated. Introduced flag-region/marker layout lesson,not a simple filled shape stimulus. No material or recognition code inherent in an outline.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: 1.2mm native line samples;3.1mm minimum centre guard;logical part contacts share samples;physical continuity andreaderrecognition pending.
